questions.question: What does Isaiah 52 call beautiful upon the mountains?
options: The crown of the king, all set about with precious jewels
The wide gates of the holy temple, thrown open very wide
The high walls of the great city, all rebuilt in their glory
The feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace
questions.answer: The feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace

questions.question: What does Isaiah 52 begin to say about the servant at its end?
options: He will conquer all of the nations with the edge of the sword
He will reign in great splendor over a golden and glorious city
He will be high and lifted up, yet his appearance was marred
He will be hidden far away and shall never once be seen again
questions.answer: He will be high and lifted up, yet his appearance was marred
